# AI利用OKの公募・コンテスト・ハッカソンまとめ
> 生成AIの利用が認められている（または要項で禁止されていない）、参加無料・日本在住の個人が応募できる賞金付き公募を締切順にまとめた日本語の一覧です。各項目は公式要項へのリンク付きで、更新日はページ内に記載しています。

- [一覧ページ](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/): 締切、賞金、AI利用条件、応募方法の表
- [Steam カプセル画像・スクリーンショット サイズチェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/steam-assets.html)
- [薬機法・広告表現チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/yakki-check.html)
- [特定商取引法に基づく表記 記載項目チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/tokusho-check.html)
- [ステマ規制 PR表記チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/stema-check.html)
- [字幕ファイル（SRT/VTT）チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/jimaku-check.html): YouTube・講座動画の字幕の読む速さ（文字/秒）、1行の文字数、行数、表示時間、重なり、番号崩れを確認し、タイミングの一括ずらしとSRT⇔VTT変換
- [小説コンテスト 企画書・あらすじチェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/kikakusho-check.html): タイトル・キャッチコピー・あらすじの文字数、結末を伏せたあらすじ、固有名詞の多さ、主人公の登場位置を応募前に確認
- [ゲーム不具合報告書（バグレポート）チェッカー＆日英整形](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/bug-report.html)
- [Google口コミ返信 下書きチェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/kuchikomi-henshin.html)
- [内容証明 字数・行数チェック＆謄本レイアウト・料金計算](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/naiyo-shomei.html)
- [翻訳調・AI翻訳っぽさチェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/honyakucho-check.html): flags translationese patterns in Japanese machine/AI translation output with rewrite suggestions (client-side).
- [やさしい日本語チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/yasashii-check.html): 外国人住民向けお知らせのやさしい日本語を点検（一文の長さ、敬語、二重否定、あいまい表現、ふりがなが必要な漢字、曜日なしの日付、元の文との日付・時刻・金額・電話番号の突き合わせ）
- [入金消込チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/nyukin-keshikomi.html): 銀行入金明細CSVと請求一覧を突き合わせ、一致・振込手数料差引・まとめ入金・一部入金・不明入金・未入金を判定（ブラウザ内処理）
- [時計の読み方プリント作成](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/tokei-yomi.html): analog-clock reading worksheets (on the hour/half, 5-min, 1-min), draw-the-hands and elapsed-time (minutes before/after) questions with answer pages; hour hand positioned exactly for the minutes.
- [ナンプレ（数独）プリント作成](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/nanpure.html): 4×4/6×6/9×9 sudoku worksheets with answer pages; every puzzle is verified to have exactly one solution.
- [3割特例・簡易課税・本則課税 消費税比較](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/sanwari-tokurei.html): For Japanese sole proprietors registered for invoices: compares consumption tax under the 2-wari tokurei (2026), the new 3-wari tokurei (2027-2028), simplified taxation and the standard method.
- [支払期日60日ルール チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/shiharai-kijitsu.html): Checks whether a Japanese closing/payment cycle (e.g. end-of-month close, pay end of following month) meets the 60-day payment rule of the Toriteki Act (2026, formerly Subcontract Act) and the Freelance Act; flags promissory notes, inspection-based start dates and vague wording, and computes 14.6% late interest.
- [おおきな字のバス時刻表 かこがわ](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/bus/kakogawa/): 加古川市コミュニティバス（かこバス・かこバスミニ）の次のバス3本を大きな文字・読み上げ・白黒反転で表示。GTFS-JP（CC BY 2.1 JP）から生成、bus/build_gtfs.py でほかの自治体のGTFS-JPにも流用可
- [少額減価償却資産 判定](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/shoukyaku-hantei.html): For Japanese sole proprietors: sorts this year's asset purchases into under-100k full expense, 3-year lump-sum depreciation, the small-asset special rule (under 300k if acquired by 2026-03-31, under 400k from 2026-04-01, 3M yen annual cap) or straight-line depreciation, with business-use ratio.
- [印紙税額チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/inshi-check.html): Japanese revenue-stamp (印紙税) amount for paper contracts and receipts: document types 1 (real-estate transfer, loans, carriage), 2 (contracting, incl. construction), 7 (basic continuous-transaction contracts, 4,000 yen) and 17 (receipts, under 50k yen exempt), with the reduced rates for real-estate and construction contracts made by 2027-03-31, tax-exclusive judging when consumption tax is stated separately, and the rule that PDF/e-contracts need no stamp.
- [AI検索おすすめ チェックシート作成](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/ai-suisen-check.html): For local businesses in Japan: builds a set of natural-language questions customers ask AI assistants (best X near station, service-specific, needs such as weekend hours or English support, price, comparison, brand-accuracy) in Japanese, English and Chinese, exports a CSV for recording results per assistant (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Mode: recommended or not, position, accuracy of description, cited sources, competitors recommended instead), and aggregates a filled CSV into recommendation share by assistant and intent, competitor counts and top cited domains.
- [ペアワイズ（オールペア）テストケース作成](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/pairwise.html): For game/app QA: turns factors and levels (OS, device, language, input, graphics, network) into a small test-case table covering every 2-factor combination, with forbidden-combination constraints, coverage stats and BOM CSV export. Runs in the browser.
- [日本語 校正チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/kousei-check.html): Japanese proofreading checker for manuscripts, blog posts, contest entries and business email: flags redundant doubled expressions (頭痛が痛い, まず最初に, 約〜ほど), ra-nuki / re-tasu / sa-ire verb forms, double honorifics (おっしゃられる, ご覧になられる, 拝見させていただく) and part-timer keigo, misused idioms (汚名挽回, 的を得る), wordy phrases, three or more sentences with the same ending, long sentences without commas and chains of の; optional exclusion of dialogue in 「」, ignore list, and one-click replacement only for fixes with a single correct form (with conjugation). Runs in the browser.
